name: Ahwa & Waghai Basic Hotels (various)

booking.notes: Simple lodges and guesthouses in both towns; walk-in or phone booking. Ahwa's matter for interior-circuit overnights, Waghai's for early ghat starts. Named alternatives now have their own records — see Pravasi Gruh in Ahwa and the government circuit house below.

notes: Function over charm — these towns are the practical overnights for waterfall-circuit and Ramayana-trail days that outgrow a Saputara base.
